verdict.rationale: Warp documents the Oz CLI explicitly for 'running and managing Warp's cloud agents from any terminal, script, or CI pipeline,' supporting local/remote agent runs, MCP connections, triggers (Slack/Linear/GitHub/webhooks), and schedules for recurring automated tasks — all clear headless/CI automation primitives. There's also a standalone Warp Agent CLI usable outside the GUI app across various terminals. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the Oz CLI or Agent CLI actually running successfully inside a real CI pipeline (only vendor docs describe this).
